content: Yuu Bapilone Anda Taone Doko Lalyuo Burumbara Peya
Dopa pipeyamo dokopa aŋala mende yakena piso epeyamo kandeyo. Baa porai renge paleta banya yanga paupau lenge dokome isa yuu peparaena yanganyi peeyo epeya.

Baame pii rekyae koo lapala, Yuu andake Bapilone pamuku enda ingingi doko isa pwuamo leya. Taone andake doko lalyuo burumbara pupyamopa imambu ama koo dupwa epapala palaminyiko. Dee yaka ama koo karo petenge dupwa palaminyiko.

Doko wambu rara peparaeme baa role pyao pasendiya yulu piyami doko banya waene porai dopakale neyamisa piya. Dee kiŋi akali dupwame baa kando nyepala role papyuo nyuo kareyami. Dee bisinase akali dupwame banya yulu koo kyaŋe singi dokona mana nyepala pyuo karo isa bangena kamongo kareyamipya.
Enakana yake dokona piso kyakale mende dee lao epeyamo siyunu dokome,

content.text: Nambana enda akali dupwa
yulu koo dokona role pyao pisarami.
Pipala dokona yole koo doko nyisaramiŋi
dokona lao mata maiyuo rekya lao pupwape.
Banya yulu koo pyuoko peteyamo dupwa
kyau pyao ama yuu dulu yake dokona pupyamopa
Anatu baame enda baa kame see napala suu pyaro karamo.
Baa wambu malu kwaenyi nembeyamo dokona makande minyuo
baa ama kamba soo kaeyo kwaoko penale.
Baame waene porai dupwa kapona keyano pilya kande
dokona nakamame porai doko minyuo komondo kata palyapala
baa kaumi kumuo nena lao mairaminyi nara leya.
Enda banya kingi range ketae nembo
kalya malyape piyamo dokona manda manjo
mona anda randa koo nao ee lao penale.
Baa mona anda dorena lao
namba kiŋinya etenge dokome
kuini endana rate wambu iso petenge
dokona peto kande.
Namba mee waiya petonde daa.
Mona kenda pingi yulu paliramopa
ee lao pisirunde daa lao petamo.
Dopa pyuo laramosa koo wakale wakale dupwa
enda baa keta yuu gii mendaki dokonako
mee komondo kata palyuo epara.
Epara dokome yuu andake doko
anga ikyane kiso maiyuo lopo andake soo
mona rando papala rao muku sera.
Doko Kamongo Anatu Porai dokome
baa kote laramosa pira leya.

content: Isa kiŋi akali enda baapa pasendiya yulu pyuo rae rae maiyuo kareyami dupwa anda taone doko rao kyau lao eparamo kandapala ee dokome kata kanda narami.
Nakama baa randa nyeramo doko kando pakapala ama nanesa karo kando karo lao, Yuu anda malu karenge Bapilone kandale doko kopyali ingyuo mee waiya lao koo keta palyuo pwuamo, wamao lao kararami.
Bisinase akali dupwa opetae enda banya lao dee bisinase pyuope ropo pyao pii naramalyamo lapala ee lao yamarangyuo kararami.

Nakamana kana golo dee kulingipi kana malu penge mola kare kare bange keyange wakasape dupwa, dee ropo pyaramande daalyamo leyami. Komau keyange rara wakale wakale dupwape isa keyangepe kapa kyarasi mee kapape mena elepande nenge dupwape kana keyangepe dupwame nyepala bange keyange wasiyami dupwape

nenge kyaa pilyamo, kopo nenge dupwape rendamu pingipi mamba kyaa pingipi waene ipwange mamba wele polawape kenapa dee bulamakao sipisipi mena osepe nakamana uliuli ipyuo nyingi dupwape dee kendemande akali ropo pyao nyiyami dupwa peparaepe mee pyalingi nyuo pwuamo lapala mona nembo kararami.
Bisinase yulu pyuo karenge akali dupwa baa kando lao, Isa bange keyange embena mona nyiyamo dupwa isa puu pao paramosa dee kando nyii nare lao kararami.
Akali lapo taone andake dokona karo bisinase pyuo kamongoyami dupwa randa nyisarama lapala mee nanesale karo ee lao ipwakuku nyuo kararami.
Nakamame lao, Taone andake doko randa koo nyilyamo kanda nalyamisi? Baa komau keyange rara wakale dupwa wapuo kana golope kulingipi dee mola kana mone malu pengepe pee pipala peteya kanda.
Doko baa yuu gii mendaki dokona pendewa inginyi nembo isa pelyamolamo larami.

Namba kandeyono dokopa ipwa sipu dupwana akali mupwape dee sipunya mee papyuo karenge wambu dupwape sipunya yulu pingi akali dupwape dee ipwa kotana bisinase yulu pingi akali dupwape nanesale karo taone doko isare rao kyau leyamo kandapala pii rekyae lao, Taone andake doko manda manjo mendasa dopale kara nange leyami.

Lapala nakama pee awaipi pyao ee lao, Taone andake kandale doko kopyali ingyuo mee waiya lao koo keta palyuo pwuamo leyami. Taone andake dokonako sipu yulu minyingi akali dupwa bange manjo epo kamongo peyami. Doko baa yuu gii mendaki mee pyalingi nyuo pelyamo lao kareyami.

Enda baa koo keta palu palyuo para dokona lao yake doko emba rae maipi. Dopako pyuo Anatunya wambupi dee aposele poropeta akalipi peparae enda baame nakama kando koo pyuo karapya dokona Anatumi baa kando pyao kokwa silyamo dokona rae maiyalapape leya.

Enakana aŋala porai mendeme kana ama reeko mende nyuo ipwa kota dokona pyao nembo karo lao, Taone andake yuu Bapilone kandale doko dopa pyuo pyao kokwa sinyi nembelyamo doko dee kandaraminde daalyamo leya.

Dopa pilyamo dokona yuu Bapilone niliyanda rambyalu kurulupi dee bikuli dokome akali singi dupwame kenane pyaraminyi dee seraminde daa lyakande. Kaname witi jingi pyao rakyingi dokona kelakalo laramo dee see naramiyoko.

Emba keta isare mende dee sinyi pyuo raa nara. Enda yapo lapo pyao nyuo pii naraminyipa yuu apa sera lyakande. Embena bisinase akali dupwa wambo dokopa ama kamongapala mee dupwa isa palyuo kareyami. Embame wambu peparae isokome pyao nyuo kareyamiko.
Poropeta akali dupwanape dee Anatunya wambu dupwana ranjama dupwape taone andake doko keta palamo. Dee wambu peparae pyao nakamana ranjama kulimbuyaminyi ranjama doko nakama keta kwualyamoko.
